messages:
olivia: Follow-up: quickstart curl failing with TLS and then a 402 body.
olivia: curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/firstcall -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -> x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

olivia: If I bypass cert check the body is {"error":"workspace_pending_billing","message":"workspace needs billing setup"} but Console shows a card.
samir: Two common root causes: corporate proxy CA and wrong token/org. Run `curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/whoami -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` to confirm org_id.

jake: Also grab `curl -v` TLS snippet to confirm if the server cert is the corporate proxy.
olivia: whoami returned org_id: org_test_77; Console shows org_prod_01. I accidentally used my personal token. That explains billing.
samir: For the CA, options: add corp CA to system truststore, or set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE / NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS. Quick example: `export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/home/me/corp-ca.pem`.
olivia: switched token + set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE -> quickstart succeeded. Thanks.
devex-bot: Note: doc opportunity flagged: add a short "whoami first" step and a troubleshooting note about corporate proxies and wrong-token billing mismatch.
olivia: I'll file a docs PR with a whoami snippet and a short proxy troubleshooting blurb.
samir: SGTM. Also consider surfacing a clearer API error when token org != dashboard org.
olivia: filing the PR now :raised_hands:
